units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>המוֹחֵק ע״מ וכ׳</he> he who rubs out in order to write over the erasure.
<cite ref="Sotah 18a:2">Sot. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כתב אות אחת ומ׳ וכ׳</he> if he wrote (the adjuration of the Sotah) by writing and washing off letter by letter.
<cite ref="Sotah 18a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ומְחָקָן לתוך וכ׳</he> and washed them off in one cup.
<cite ref="Shabbat 75b:4">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ אות גדולה</he> if he erased one large letter.

<cite ref="Shabbat 75b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>זה חומר במוֹחֵק וכ׳</he> in this case he who erases, is more severely dealt with than he who writes (on the Sabbath); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00832"><he>מָחוּק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:20">Ab. IV, 20</cite> <he>נייר מ׳</he> erased papyrus (palimpsest).

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 73a:8">73ᵃ</cite>) <he>המעבד … והמוֹחֲקוֹ</he> Mish. a. Y. ed. (Bab. <he>והמְמַחֲקוֹ</he>) he who tans its skin, and he who scrapes it. Y. ib. 10ᶜ bot. <he>חייב משום מוחק</he> is guilty of an act coming under the category of scraping. Ib. 10ᵃ <he>המוֹחֲקָהּ</he> he who planes the beam; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:11">B. Bath. V, 11</cite> <he>לִמְחוֹק … יִמְחוֹק</he>, v. <cite ref="C00252"><he>גָּדַשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 153b:5">Sabb. 153ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:17">Tosef. ib. I, 17</cite> <he>מָחֲקוּ סאה</he> they made the measure (of laws passed) just even (so that anything added would make it overflow), opp. <cite ref="C00252"><he>גָּדַשׁ</he></cite>; Y. ib. I, 3ᶜ; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M00832"><he>מְחוֹק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 18a:8">Ib. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>קודם שנִמְחֲקָה מגילה</he> before the roll (containing the adjuration of the Sotah) has been washed off.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 164a:10">B. Bath. 164ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ בן יומו</he> an erasure of one day’s standing, <he>נ׳ בן שני ימים</he> an erasure two days old; a. e.
<cite ref="Shabbat 73a">Sabb. 73ᵃ</cite>, v. supra. Y. ib. VII, 10ᵈ top <he>חייב משום מְמַחֵק</he> is guilty of an act coming under the category of scraping; a. fr.
